shellCommands.command: ls -a && cat package.json AGENTS.md && ls -R .agents | head -80

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/.agents/skills/gravity-ui && sed -n 1,80p references/package-routing.md; grep -n -i -C4 "chartkit\|charts" references/package-routing.md | sed -n 1,150p; cat rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -150
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && find src __agent_eval__ -type f | head -50; cat vite.config.ts tsconfig.json index.html; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx; head -40 __agent_eval__/run.mjs; sed -n 480,520p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>&1 | head; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'

npm view @gravity-ui/chartkit version peerDependencies dependencies 2>&1 | head -40; npm view @gravity-ui/charts version peerDependencies 2>&1 | head -20; npm view @gravity-ui/yagr version peerDependencies 2>&1|head

npm view @gravity-ui/chartkit versions --json | tr -d '\n ' | tail -c 400; echo; for v in 7.0.0 8.0.0; do echo $v; npm view @gravity-ui/chartkit@$v peerDependencies dependencies 2>&1 | head -20; done; npm view @gravity-ui/charts versions --json | tr -d '\n ' | tail -c 200

npm view @gravity-ui/chartkit@8.12.0 peerDependencies 2>&1 | head; npm install @gravity-ui/chartkit@^8.12.0 2>&1 | tail -8; for p in chartkit charts yagr; do grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/$p/package.json; done; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/docs 2>&1 | head -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit && cat build/docs/INDEX.md | head -120; ls build/docs/guides; ls node_modules node_modules/@gravity-ui 2>&1 | head; grep -n '"\./' package.json | head -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins && cat yagr/index.js yagr/renderer/index.js gravity-charts/index.js 2>&1 | head -60; ls yagr gravity-charts; cat yagr/types.d.ts | head -60; cat gravity-charts/types.d.ts | head -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build && sed -n 1,80p components/ChartKit.d.ts 2>/dev/null; ls components; cat types/index.d.ts | head -80; ls plugins/yagr/renderer; sed -n 1,80p plugins/yagr/renderer/YagrWidget.js

cat libs/settings/settings.js | head -40; grep -n "RawSerieData\b" -A12 ../../yagr/dist/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; ls ../../yagr/dist | head; ls ../node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/build/types/chart 2>/dev/null | head -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts && grep '"version"' package.json; ls build | head; cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist && grep -rn "RawSerieData" --include=*.d.ts . | head -5; grep -n "type MinimalValidConfig" -A12 YagrCore/types.d.ts | head -30; grep -n "interface RawSerieData" -A25 YagrCore/types.d.ts | head -40

sed -n 295,320p YagrCore/types.d.ts; grep -n "title\|timeline" YagrCore/types.d.ts | head -20; cd ../../chartkit/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts && ls; ls dist 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rn "ChartData = \|type ChartData\b" --include=*.d.ts . | head -3

ls dist/docs; grep -n "xAxis\|type: 'datetime'\|datetime" -r dist/docs | head -15; grep -rn "chartkit" dist/docs | head -3; sed -n 195,260p ../../../../yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null; grep -n "id: string\|id?" ../../../build/plugins/yagr/renderer/useWidgetData.js | head
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist && grep -n "interface YagrChartOptions" -A22 YagrCore/types.d.ts; grep -n "series?:" YagrCore/types.d.ts | head
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -20; npx vite build 2>&1 | grep -E "index-|Widget|built|error" ; cat .gitignore; git status --short
grep -E "script|modulepreload|stylesheet" dist/index.html; grep -l "uPlot\|d3-scale" dist/assets/index-*.js; rm -rf dist; git diff package.json
